content_of_post_to_answer: How do I study long and effectively with focus?
answer: Long study sessions fail less because of time and more because of attention quality. Many people try to force focus while their mind is still unclear about what it is doing. The better approach is to create a rhythm: define a specific problem to solve, work deeply, then recover before attention collapses. I’ve written more about this pattern on my profile for those who want a deeper breakdown. Focus is not the ability to sit longer; it is the ability to return to the task repeatedly with less friction.
